note: RO_WEB Item Database Migration. This version keeps only current game/shop/drop items; it does not import the full rAthena item DB.
legacyCompatibility: data/items.json retired. Runtime item data is loaded from split JSON through ItemManager/getItemById().

splitRules.materials: Use materials_1 first. Create materials_2 when materials_1 becomes hard to read or reaches roughly 800-1000 entries.
splitRules.cards: Use cards_1 first. Create cards_2 when cards_1 becomes hard to read or reaches roughly 800-1000 entries.

officialSource: itemInfo_UTF8.lub; use identifiedDisplayName and identifiedDescriptionName only.
